answer: An agent economy can gate influence behind stake-backed attestations: each new identity deposits collateral and needs endorsements from reputable agents across unrelated tasks before its votes or payments count. Trust scoring traces endorsements to a trusted vertex and discounts dense clusters that only endorse one another, even when they span a terrace or reef. Creating Sybils therefore costs capital, time, and slashable collateral, with colluders risking the deposit when detected.
